reason: It's right at my subway exit and a strawberry cheesecake matcha is something I'd try once out of curiosity. Whether I come back depends entirely on whether the matcha underneath is actually good or just sugar and syrup.
objection: $8 is a lot for a latte, and flavored matchas are often low-grade powder hidden under sweet toppings. They don't say anything about where the matcha comes from or what grade it is.
would_change_my_mind: Naming the matcha source and grade (ceremonial, a named Uji farm) would make me a regular instead of a two-time visitor.
